scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:portable && pnpm run lint:gitleaks && pnpm run lint:swift && pnpm run lint:dotnet
scripts.lint:ast-grep: vouchington ast-grep-examples --rules ast-grep-rules --config sgconfig.yml && ast-grep scan --error --no-ignore hidden -- swift-clients/ dotnet-clients/
scripts.lint:format: oxfmt --check scripts tests package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github .claude .codex .cursor .grok docs README.md CLAUDE.md
scripts.lint:github-actions: mise exec -- actionlint && mise exec -- zizmor --offline --min-severity high --min-confidence high . && vouchington gha-workspace-policy
scripts.lint:portable: pnpm run lint:format && pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:ast-grep && pnpm run lint:complexity && pnpm run lint:no-mistakes && pnpm run lint:dependencies && pnpm run lint:github-actions && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run lint:links && pnpm run lint:diff
scripts.lint:shell: git ls-files -z '*.sh' 'dev/*' | xargs -0 mise exec -- shellcheck
